test_title: PYST 56: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

__Despite of__ an injury, he won the match.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Despite".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** "Despite"** is used to indicate that something happened or is true even though something else might have prevented it.
 
• In this sentence,** "Despite"** is the appropriate word to use because it indicates that winning the match occurred in the face of the obstacle of the injury.
 
 
• **Example**: Despite his height, he cannot play good basketball.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** "Despite".**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The rest of the options are incorrect because,
 
• **"In spite of" **is also a valid phrase, that means the same thing. it is followed by the noun or pronoun. it is referring to (**"In spite of the injury".**)
 
• **"In despite of" **is not a correct phrase in English.
